integrity: Symbolic proof of necessary-and-sufficient equivalence and pair enumeration; standalone deterministic finite checker complements but does not replace the all-length argument.
scientific_limitations: Binary length at least three, precisely three ones; no claims for larger weights or general alphabets; residual risk of an earlier unindexed equivalent proof.
title: Exact weight-three binary three-deck equivalence and proof of the Chrisnata–Kiah–Karingula–Vardy–Yaakobi–Yao conjecture
